import json, pathlib, runner_app, bridge_reference.protocol as p
from runner_app.resources import SCHEMA_NAMES, load_schema
import jsonschema
assert "site-packages" in runner_app.__file__, runner_app.__file__
assert "site-packages" in str(p.SCHEMAS), p.SCHEMAS
for name in SCHEMA_NAMES:
    s=load_schema(name); jsonschema.Draft202012Validator.check_schema(s)
    assert s==json.loads((p.SCHEMAS/(name+".schema.json")).read_text())
try:p.validate_schema({},"command")
except p.Rejected as e:assert e.code=="INVALID_SCHEMA"
else:raise AssertionError("Reference validator not active")
print(json.dumps({"runner_import":runner_app.__file__,"reference_import":p.__file__,"schemas":sorted(SCHEMA_NAMES),"count":len(SCHEMA_NAMES),"isolated":True}))
